## Summary
This package owns RTP interceptors that discover or repair simulcast and RTX stream identity metadata. It wraps remote RTP readers to inspect MID, RID, and repaired RID header extensions, report RTX repair/base SSRC pairs, and inject missing simulcast identity extensions for configured streams.

## Responsibilities
- Create interceptor factories for RTX metadata extraction and unhandled simulcast repair.
- Probe remote RTP streams for MID, RID, and repaired RID header extensions.
- Match RTX repair streams with their base streams by MID and RID/RSID metadata.
- Inject missing simulcast MID, RID, or repaired RID extensions when stream metadata is configured.
- Preserve original readers when required header extensions or configured stream metadata are unavailable.
